title: Hello · Lionel Richie
description: The complete supplied video, original music with physical singing and dialogue.

melody.name: Hello
melody.lyrics: Listen up everybody. Tony Billy Boy has been in prison for twenty five years. He's only been out for three days. The last time you were a free man, the Brooklyn Dodgers were still Brooklyn Dodgers and Eisenhower was your president. Laura, Amanda's intrigued with Billy Boy. Billy Boy, ask Amanda for a date. I've been alone with you inside my mind And in my dreams I've kissed your lips a thousand times I sometimes see you pass outside my door, hello, is it me you're looking for? I can see it in your eyes, I can see it in your smile, You're all I've ever wanted My arms are open wide Cause you know just what to say And you know just what to do And I want to tell you so much I love you I long to see the sunlight in your hair And tell you time and time again How much I care Sometimes I feel my heart will overflow Hello I've just got to let you know Cause I wonder where you are And I wonder what you do Are you somewhere feeling lonely Or is someone loving you? Tell me how to win your heart For I haven't got a clue But let me start by saying I love you Hello? Is it me you're looking for? Cause I wonder where you are And I wonder what you do Are you somewhere feeling lonely? Or is someone loving you Tell me how to win your heart For I haven't got a clue But let me start by saying I love you Oh, it's wonderful. Hello, is it me you're looking for?

parts.name: Laura · the acting student and artist

melody.name: Hello
melody.lyrics: There is no more Brooklyn Paramount. It's been taken over by some college. That's gone too. You're a regular Rip Van Winkle, aren't you? What have you been doing the past few weeks? I can't believe it. It isn't good for you, baby boy. Too many memories, too many ghosts. We could go to Florida, or we could go out west. What are you telling me? Hello? Hello? I've wanted you to see it so many times, but I finally think it's done. Tell me what you think of it. This is how I see you.
